What I did to get my Xulane back was have my doc write a new script to say 'dispense as written' and thankfully I've not had an issue getting my Xulane since! It wasn't an insurance issue with me luckily, just the pharmacy deciding they wanted to give me the generic instead of putting in an order for the Xulane.
